currentUserGoal: Make the top mobile HUD smaller, remove ornate borders, and improve readability with icons, numbers, and short text.
changesMade: Converted the mobile HUD chips from wrapped ornate cards into a single slim metrics strip with simple dark backing.
Hid ornate frame details on mobile for HUD chips, combo badge, and goal nudge while preserving desktop/tablet ornate styling.
Reduced mobile title/build label sizes and tightened header spacing.
Added compact mobile number/rate formatting such as 2.5k and 176k/m so chip text can stay larger.
Removed the duplicate mobile Quest ready milestone row when quest chip and goal nudge already communicate it.
Lowered the mobile board top reserve so the play field starts higher after the HUD shrinks.
verification: Mobile visual check at http://127.0.0.1:5173/?stress&perf&tiles=1200&v=compact-mobile-hud-2 using 390x844 viewport: HUD is a slim one-row metric strip with a small nudge line, no ornate chip borders, compact values, and the board starts higher.
